subject: Prepladder Tests
title: FMGE Mini Test Series · FMGE Mini Test Series Year 2023 · Fmge Mini Test 5 (Nutrition)

questions.stem: A 34-year-old woman presented with generalized weakness and lightheadedness for 2 weeks. Blood investigations were notable for decreased hemoglobin, increased indirect bilirubin, and increased LDH. Her peripheral smear showed RBC fragments. Which vitamin deficiency is associated with the above presentation?
